title: Count Pairs With Given Sum
description: Given an array of integers and a target sum, count how many pairs of indices (i, j) with i < j have arr[i] + arr[j] equal to the target.
InputFormat:
Line 1: n (array length)
Line 2: n space-separated integers (the array)
Line 3: target integer
referenceSolution:
import sys

def solve(arr, target):
    seen = {}
    count = 0
    for x in arr:
        need = target - x
        if need in seen:
            count += seen[need]
        seen[x] = seen.get(x, 0) + 1
    return count

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(data[0])
arr = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
target = int(data[1+n])
print(solve(arr, target))

examples.explanation: Pairs (2,4) and (3,3-index) sum to 6: (2,4) and (3 at index2, 3 at index4).
